variation.scope: lifts 4-7 re-pitched, 7 lifts total, height to 15.0 m

notes.erector_note: Extra lift added for roof access.
notes.inspector_remark: Lift 5 toe board replaced and rechecked.

deciding.design_conformity: Height and lift count are covered by variation V-21, but the proposed tag is class 3 against design class 2 with only 4 boards, a load departure outside the variation scope.
deciding.handover_decision: The tag proposal exceeds the design class, so release must be limited to class 2; the defect is closed and reinspected and no document is outstanding.
deciding.limiting_issue: The only defect (lift 5 toe board) is closed and reinspected, which leaves component_defect against none_found; the structure itself matches the approved variation.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Height 15.0 m against design max 12.0 m is exactly 25% over, on the line between levels 2 and 3; the lift count of 7 against 6 is 16.7%.
deciding.releasable_share: The one defect is closed and reinspected and the structure matches the variation, so every lift is releasable at its design class 2 use.
